displayName: TCGplayer API - Card Market Prices, Price History, Listings, Sellers
description: TCGplayer API as structured JSON - search tcgplayer.com cards and sealed products across Pokemon, Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Lorcana and every other game (71 product lines), read one product with the market price of every SKU (condition x printing x language) and its recent sale range, page every live seller listing with price, shipping and seller rating, pull up to a year of price history with quantity sold per day or week, the 5 most recent sales, a whole set's price guide, every set of a game, autocomplete, trending searches, and a seller's profile, buyer feedback and catalogue. 13 endpoints, 1 credit each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
